updates.headline: v0.2.10 - Chapter Normal pursuit tuning
updates.summary: Chapter Normal movement reduced from 5.0 to 4.8 while retaining 100 HP, 5 damage and all other balance values.

categories.name: Combat Balance Pass 1.1
changes: TUNING: Chapter 1 Normal enemy movement speed is reduced from 5.0 to 4.8 for the next manual kiting test. HP remains 100 and damage remains 5.

PRESERVED: Player movement, Hounds, Throwers, weapons, abilities, spawn counts and encounter pacing are unchanged. Fresh DPS forward, backward and strafing all use the full 5-unit/sec movement limit; there is no backpedal penalty. Legacy enemy prefabs remain untouched.

updates.headline: v0.2.9 - Chapter Rank-0 combat baseline
updates.summary: Prototype fresh DPS, Normal, Hound and stationary Thrower tuning, fixed Thrower cadence and a finite Bullet Rain tick budget. Pending manual feel testing.

categories.name: Combat Balance Pass 1
changes: PROTOTYPE: Chapter 1 fresh DPS now uses 100 HP, zero Armor, 5 movement speed and 10 primary damage at 3 shots/sec. Crit remains 0% with a 2x multiplier; Regen/Lifesteal remain zero. Dash cooldown is 5 seconds and fresh Micro-Grenade damage is 30 with a 10-second cooldown.
PROTOTYPE: Bullet Rain delivers exactly 12 base ticks of 5 damage across 6 seconds at 0.5-second intervals, with a 20-second cooldown. Its initial tick is included in the finite Chapter tick budget.

PROTOTYPE: Chapter Normal enemies use 100 HP / 5 speed / 5 damage; Hounds use 75 HP / 5.5 speed, plus 0.5 while flanking / 10 damage. Stationary Throwers use 500 HP, fixed 1-second preparation / 4-second reload and 30 melee damage; alive-count cadence is retired.

PRESERVED: Permanent Stats/Mastery tuning, authored ability geometry, mission populations, spawn pacing, Armor recovery and legacy combat assets remain unchanged. No progression-based enemy scaling is added. Balance Pass 1 is pending manual feel testing.

updates.headline: v0.2.8 - Chapter HUD cleanup
updates.summary: Retired run XP stays hidden and Chapter Armor appears only when live effective Armor capacity exists.

categories.name: Chapter HUD
changes: FIX: Chapter 1 hides the retired run/card XP bar, XP display and run-level badge during HUD setup and live refresh, including before combat bindings are ready.

IMPROVED: Chapter Armor HUD visibility follows live effective capacity. Zero capacity hides the entire bar; positive capacity remains visible when empty, such as 0/20. Runtime and temporary Armor changes refresh without a scene reload.
PRESERVED: Armor values, recharge delay, refill timing, Armor Recovery ranks and permanent progression remain unchanged. Legacy HUD paths and production scenes are preserved.

updates.headline: v0.2.7 - Chapter temporary cards retired
updates.summary: New Chapter 1 uses Permanent Stats and DPS Mastery, with safe retirement of run XP, temporary cards and obsolete card save restoration.

categories.name: Chapter progression
changes: CHANGED: NewMenu Chapter 1 gameplay now uses Permanent Stats and DPS Mastery. Temporary run XP/levels, card offers, Core card rewards and the card-only XP/level HUD are retired from this development path.

FIX: Chapter Continue, Restart and replay safely ignore obsolete selected cards and queued offers, including mission-start snapshots. Loading old card data alone does not rewrite the save or grant rewards.

PRESERVED: Permanent profile resources, Stats/Mastery effects and isolated replay remain intact. Legacy menus, LATEST, Endless and their card code/assets retain compatibility. Mission resource rewards are still future work.

updates.headline: v0.2.6 - Chapter mission replay
updates.summary: Completed Chapter missions can replay fresh encounters while preserving furthest campaign progress and permanent profile.

categories.name: Chapter mission replay
changes: NEW: Completed Chapter Missions 1-1 through 1-5 remain marked COMPLETED and can be selected for REPLAY from NewMenu. Current missions continue normally; locked missions and Boss 1-6 remain unavailable.

IMPROVED: Replay starts a fresh selected-mission encounter using the current campaign build. Finishing, restarting or exiting replay preserves the furthest campaign progress, checkpoints and normal suspension; completed missions are not relocked.

PRESERVED: Replay uses the existing isolated, read-only session and Save & Exit safeguards. Permanent profile progression and neighboring Story saves remain untouched. No new objectives, rewards, balance changes or player-facing Story Reset controls.

updates.headline: v0.2.5 - NewMenu readability pass
updates.summary: Saved Player Level beside Credits, wrapped Mastery details and clearer text spacing across the existing 6 × 2 Stats grid.

categories.name: NewMenu readability
changes: IMPROVED: The global profile header now shows the saved Player Level next to Credits; Player XP remains hidden.
IMPROVED: Mastery node labels and the detail panel wrap longer names, descriptions, effects, prerequisites and states inside their panels.
IMPROVED: Stats keeps the 6 × 2 card grid while giving titles, descriptions, next effects and button states more room to wrap at readable sizes.
PRESERVED: Menu navigation, saved progression, Stat values and prices, Mastery costs and effects, the production MainMenu and gameplay behavior.

updates.headline: v0.2.4 - Permanent DPS Stats prototype
updates.summary: Twelve Credit-based permanent DPS Stats cards, exclusive recovery paths and confirmed Armor recharge/refill timings in the development NewMenu.

categories.name: Permanent DPS Stats prototype
changes: PROTOTYPE: NewMenu STATS now offers twelve permanent DPS upgrade cards. Each rank costs 100 Credits with configurable prototype values, saved ranks and immediate balance updates.

NEW: HP Regen and Lifesteal are exclusive permanent recovery paths: the first rank locks the other. HP/Armor capacities, AD/AP, primary Fire Rate, movement, ability CDR, Crit Chance and traveling-projectile speed compose with existing Mastery and temporary card systems.

PROTOTYPE: DPS Armor waits five seconds after damage, then refills from empty over four base seconds. Armor Recovery ranks reduce refill duration to 3.6, 3.2, 2.8 and 2.4 seconds; global CDR affects neither recharge delay nor refill.

CHANGED: Removed the temporary RESET STORY controls from NewMenu PLAY. Canonical saves remain intact; mission replay and rewards are future work. The production menu, legacy scenes and build startup remain unchanged.

updates.headline: v0.2.3 - DPS Mastery prototype and Story reset
updates.summary: A persistent direct-spend DPS Mastery prototype in NewMenu, with free respec and confirmed active-campaign Story reset.

categories.name: DPS Mastery prototype
changes: PROTOTYPE: NewMenu now includes a functional DPS Mastery tree: four sequential five-node branches, direct spending of 50 Mastery XP per node, persistent unlocks and a selected-node detail panel. All 20 nodes currently cost 1000 XP in total.

PROTOTYPE: Primary Attack, Dash, Micro-Grenade and Bullet Rain upgrades use configurable prototype values in the Offline Chapter DPS development flow. RESET MASTERY is free, refunds recorded node costs and preserves lifetime Mastery XP earned.
NEW: Confirmed RESET STORY on the NewMenu PLAY page restarts only the active Chapter campaign. Permanent profile progression, Mastery unlocks and other Story saves are preserved.
PRESERVED: The production MainMenu, LATEST, authored Chapter1_Blockout and build startup remain unchanged. Mission rewards, permanent Stats upgrades, final balance and Mission 1-6 remain future work.

updates.headline: v0.2.2 - Chapter menu development shell
updates.summary: A separate, plain NewMenu development scene for Chapter 1 navigation, shared Credits and recent updates, while the production menu remains unchanged.

categories.name: Development menu foundation
changes: DEVELOPMENT: Added a separate NewMenu scene with simple PLAY, MASTERY, STATS and SETTINGS navigation, persistent Credits, scrolling recent Patch Notes and a separate Quit action. The current production menu remains unchanged.

DEVELOPMENT: PLAY presents the active Chapter 1 campaign with completed/current/locked mission nodes, larger CORE and BOSS nodes, and the existing Chapter1_Blockout launch/resume path. Mission 1-6 remains locked; save-slot persistence is preserved.
FOUNDATION: Mastery and Stats pages are placeholders only. Existing Settings, profile progression and gameplay systems remain intact; NewMenu is not the production startup scene.

updates.headline: v0.2.1 - Persistent progression foundation
updates.summary: A shared permanent profile foundation for Player XP, Player Level, Credits and direct-spend DPS Mastery XP, plus retirement of DPS fire-rate stacking.

categories.name: Progression foundation
changes: FOUNDATION: Added shared permanent player-profile support for Player XP, Player Level, Credits and DPS Mastery XP, separate from the three Story campaigns.
CHANGED: Retired the DPS temporary stacking Fire Rate passive and its HUD tile. Normal primary fire and abilities retain their existing base behavior.

FOUNDATION: Credits and direct-spend DPS Mastery XP support safe save/load and spending. Mission rewards, Stats purchases and mastery nodes remain future work; Player Level currently grants no gameplay bonuses.

updates.headline: v0.1.99 - Temporary Chapter 1-5 skeleton
updates.summary: Save-first district transitions, temporary 50-Normal missions, a Core/Thrower placeholder finale and compatible Story suspension.

categories.name: Temporary Offline Story route
changes: NEW: The temporary Offline Chapter route now continues through Missions 1-3, 1-4 and 1-5 using the manually authored districts, checkpoints, entries, destination Marks and doors. These encounters are skeletons pending later redesign.

IMPROVED: Corridor checkpoint crossings save the next mission before its physical entry/title/encounter. Continue from a waiting checkpoint places the player safely just before the authored district entry; rear closure waits for whole-body doorway clearance.

NEW: Temporary Missions 1-3 and 1-4 each require 50 legitimate Normal kills from their own authored spawn regions. Their paired doors close on arrival and the forward route opens on secured completion.

NEW: Temporary Mission 1-5 keeps the authored visual Core and reuses four canonical Throwers and owned held/flying/landed Normals. Boundary 6 B closes as a single sliding wall using the authored gap; all Throwers and owned survivors must die.
NEW: Completed temporary 1-5 is saved before returning to Main Menu. Mission 1-6 stays locked; no Boss or final Core-defense/reward design is added.

PRESERVED: Three independent Story slots, existing 1-1/1-2 gameplay, restart/build data and read-only replay. Minimal 3/4/5 actor/gate/entry snapshots extend the existing suspend system, and physical floor-based minimap/waypoint handoffs retain the current styling. No adaptive pathfinding, Online or Endless changes.

updates.headline: v0.1.98 - District 2 encounter pressure
updates.summary: Surviving Throwers accelerate through a fixed timing ladder, with one-second uncapped prototype Hound pressure and unchanged damage/flight.

categories.name: District 2 prototype tuning
changes: TUNING: Main District 2 Throwers accelerate as teammates legitimately die: preparation/reload seconds are 4/2 with four alive, 3/1.5 with three, 2/1 with two and 1/0.5 with one.

IMPROVED: Cadence changes apply immediately to surviving Throwers. Partial reload/preparation segments retain proportional progress without restarting or adding remaining time; duplicate death events cannot accelerate or reward twice.

TUNING: Main-encounter Hounds now attempt one spawn per second with the active cap explicitly disabled for this prototype. The cap remains configurable for later balancing; all six authored sources and valid-ground/player-clearance rules remain.

PRESERVED: Pause, inactive phases and missed opportunities do not build a catch-up spawn burst. The fourth legitimate Thrower death stops new Hounds immediately; all existing owned survivors remain required by the fixed cleanup countdown.

PRESERVED: Four 1000-HP Throwers, one held Normal each, existing flight arcs/destinations/duration, damageability/HP/landing, incoming damage, movement, A/B/C/D HUD, Hound introduction, Practice and navigation. Current suspend/restart behavior remains compatible.
PROTOTYPE: Unlimited Hound pressure is intentionally aggressive and still requires human balance and sustained performance testing.

updates.headline: v0.1.97 - Story navigation and Practice guidance
updates.summary: Persistent corridor waypoints, physical District 2 minimap handoff, arrival breathing, target orientation and prompt District 3 guidance.

categories.name: Navigation and communication
changes: FIX: The real District 2 world destination appears as soon as the recovered District 1 gate opens and stays through the corridor, checkpoint commit and district title. Physical arena entry takes over navigation and the Pause objective.

FIX: District 2 minimap framing uses its authored floor bounds instead of outlying boundary-group visuals. Corridor overview remains until genuine arena entry, then the existing minimap smoothly frames District 2.
IMPROVED: District 2 opening combat starts after a configurable 2.5-second breathing beat following gate closure. Player control and the later scent/Hound introduction remain unchanged.

IMPROVED: Safe Practice stand entry activates barriers and a world-only TARGETS marker at PracticeLaunchOrigin for a configurable 2.5 seconds before the first target. Player view stays free; subsequent groups keep their one-second resolution-based cadence.

FIX: After true District 2 completion, DISTRICT 3 guidance appears after a configurable one-second handoff, independently of the temporary secured announcement. Its marker remains on the authored District_1_3/Mark destination.

PRESERVED: Authored transforms, Hound/Thrower tuning, Practice scoring, Story slot/suspend/restart behavior and read-only development replay. Mission 1-3 gameplay and its persistent transition remain future work.

updates.headline: v0.1.96 - Mid-mission Story save and resume
updates.summary: Save & Exit preserves the current Story mission, enemies, Practice and player build together; Continue resumes the suspended session in its own save slot.

categories.name: Offline Story persistence
changes: FIX: Offline Story Save & Exit now preserves your current mission together with XP, cards, health, armor and role state. Continue resumes the suspended session instead of restarting it with advanced progression.
IMPROVED: Mission 1-1 resumes consumed opening kills, repair and cleanup progress, moving zones, ambush progress, lock recovery and gate state.
IMPROVED: Mission 1-2 resumes arena entry, Hound progress, Practice score and unresolved targets, surviving Thrower health, held/flying Normals and survivor cleanup.
FIX: Continue restores player position and view, current objectives and relevant combat HUD. Defeated enemies and resolved targets are not recreated or rewarded again.

PRESERVED: Suspensions belong to their individual Story save slots. Restart Current Stage intentionally discards the suspension and restores the canonical start/checkpoint. Existing saves remain compatible; development replay stays read-only with zero progression.

updates.headline: v0.1.95 - Three Offline Story campaigns
updates.summary: Three independent Story saves, last-played Continue, safe campaign migration and confirmed individual deletion.

categories.name: Offline Story saves
changes: NEW: Offline Story now opens Continue, New Save and Back. Continue resumes your most recently played campaign and is hidden when no campaign exists.
NEW: Keep up to three independent Story campaigns. Save cards show your role, mission, level and last-played time; empty saves begin through role selection.
IMPROVED: Existing Chapter progress migrates safely into Save 1, preserving missions, checkpoints, XP, cards, health, armor and role state. Each campaign progresses independently.
NEW: Delete individual Story saves with a confirmation dialog. Remaining campaigns, achievements, settings and Endless data stay intact.
PRESERVED: Completed-mission development replay remains read-only with zero progression. Tank and Healer role selection remains unchanged.

updates.headline: v0.1.94 - Story objective communication
updates.summary: Clear replay and role labels, temporary secured announcements, fixed survivor countdowns and authored District 3 navigation.

categories.name: Story and mission UI
changes: FIX: Mission role selection now reads SELECT ROLE with a fitted header. Completed-mission development replay uses the simple REPLAY label while retaining zero progression and read-only campaign protection.
IMPROVED: District 1 ambush guidance reads SURVIVE THE AMBUSH with the existing 40-enemy legitimate kill requirement.
FIX: DISTRICT 1 SECURED is a temporary announcement; afterward the real DISTRICT 2 objective and the original destination beacon return, including the Pause current objective.

FIX: District 2 cleanup snapshots owned survivors after the fourth Thrower dies and counts down against a fixed denominator. Zero survivors skip the cleanup bar; all legitimate survivors remain required.

FIX: DISTRICT 2 SECURED and PRACTICE COMPLETE use temporary feedback. After the secured announcement and gate opening, DISTRICT 3 navigation points to the exact authored Mark destination; Pause displays the real active objective.

PRESERVED: Authored transforms, repair and gate mechanics, Hound pressure, Thrower tuning, Practice gameplay, replay save protections and enemy speed 2.5. Mission 1-3 gameplay and its persistent transition remain future work.

updates.headline: v0.1.93 - District 2 combat polish
updates.summary: Grounded stationary Throwers, stronger Hound pressure, reliable grenade contacts and subtle Bullet Rain target fill.

categories.name: Combat and presentation
changes: FIX: District 2 Throwers now ground their capsule feet on the playable floor while preserving each authored A/B/C/D horizontal marker location.

IMPROVED: Throwers remain stationary, continuously face the player horizontally and freeze only their visual locomotion pose. Their rendered feet align with the grounded capsule; held Normals present above a centered upper-body anchor.
TUNING: Main-encounter Hound pressure now uses a configurable 3-second interval and active cap 12. Capped attempts are discarded and new spawning stops when all four Throwers die.

FIX: Micro-Grenade retains query-driven impacts before physical contact response, makes every projectile collider nonblocking, handles saturated contact-query buffers and accepts live enemy body/child contacts. Held or stationary disabled AI no longer receives knockback; one detonation and ObjectiveZone filtering remain.
IMPROVED: Valid Bullet Rain placement retains its outline and adds a subtle 12-percent cyan fill at the identical ground target and radius, without colliders. Invalid previews hide both.

PRESERVED: Incoming enemy damage, four Throwers with 1000 HP, one real payload, existing reload/preparation/arc timings and HP persistence, Practice UX and gates. The truthful owned-survivor cleanup counter remains unchanged.

updates.headline: v0.1.92 - District 2 Practice guidance and pacing
updates.summary: Clear interaction and stand guidance, full objective text, faster resolution-based target cadence and separated launch origins.

categories.name: Practice Machine playtest polish
changes: IMPROVED: Practice Machine guidance now uses the authored interaction/stand footprints, with a visible floor border and translucent fill during the relevant step.

FIX: Entering interaction range shows PRESS followed by the actual bound key and USE PRACTICE MACHINE. Successful use directs the player to MOVE TO PRACTICE POSITION; leaving range removes the use prompt.

FIX: Objective notifications and waypoint captions fit full gameplay text with bounded width, wrapping and sensible font sizing instead of ellipsis truncation. The minimap and compact HUD retain their layout.
IMPROVED: Practice groups now launch one second after all current targets resolve, with no overlapping groups or long fixed waiting timer. Pause freezes this delay.
FIX: The raised and widened authored PracticeLaunchOrigin is used as an oriented launch area. Singles vary, doubles launch from separated ends and triples from left/center/right positions.
PRESERVED: Ten singles, two doubles, two triples, 20 opportunities, 10/20 pass and retry, existing target arcs/hit-miss rules, Hounds, Throwers, gates and exact authored scene transforms.

updates.headline: v0.1.91 — District 2 entry and Hound introduction
updates.summary: Combat waits for real arena entry, rear walls close safely, checkpoint view faces forward, and Hound introduction uses one cumulative total.

categories.name: District 2 playtest fixes
changes: FIX: Mission 1-2 waits for the player to fully cross the authored District 2 arena-entry boundary; checkpoint spawning and corridor travel no longer start combat early.
NEW: The authored District 2 Boundary 4 A/B rear walls close symmetrically over 1.5 seconds after safe entry, preserving their exact saved open positions. Restart restores the rear gate open.

FIX: District 2 entry and Practice interaction/stand footprints are enabled invisible triggers and ignored by weapon queries. Checkpoint markers, return blocker and solid Practice barriers retain their intended roles.
FIX: Mission 1-2 checkpoint spawn resets camera pitch to level and faces the arena using authored spatial context, then resumes normal camera control.
IMPROVED: Clearing ten Normals gives a configurable 2.5-second SOMETHING HAS YOUR SCENT beat. Hound groups stay 1/3/3/5 with one continuous ELIMINATE HOUNDS counter from 0/12 to 12/12.
PRESERVED: Practice Machine firing, Thrower tuning, forward Boundary 3 exit, District 1, current HUD/minimap and authored geometry. Mission 1-3 remains unimplemented.

updates.headline: v0.1.90 — Mission 1-2: District 2
updates.summary: District 2 opening combat, Hound introduction, Practice Machine, four Throwers and a survivor-gated exit toward District 3.

categories.name: Chapter 1 gameplay
changes: NEW: Mission 1-2 is playable from the District 2 checkpoint: clear 10 Normals, then sequential Hound groups of 1, 3, 3 and 5.
NEW: The authored Practice Machine teaches single/double/triple arcs across 20 targets, passes at 10 hits and supports retry without restarting the mission.

NEW: Practice completion leads through noise warnings into four stationary Throwers at authored A/B/C/D positions, with independent health sections and real shootable held/airborne Normals that retain their HP.
NEW: Hound pressure uses a configurable five-second interval and cap eight without spawn backlog. All four Throwers and every owned survivor must die before District 2 is secured.

NEW: Boundary 3 closes at mission start and smoothly returns to its exact authored open positions after completion. A world marker points toward District 3; Mission 1-3 gameplay/checkpoint is not implemented.

PRESERVED: District 1 flow/checkpoint, compact HUD/minimap, normal weapons and authored enemy speed. DPS passive expiration freezes during downtime and remains active through survivor cleanup. Prototype encounter tuning awaits human playtesting.

updates.headline: v0.1.89 — District 1 gameplay cleanup
updates.summary: Reliable Micro-Grenade enemy impacts, pause-safe district titles, Chapter Bullet Rain targeting and clear communications-repair feedback.

categories.name: Gameplay fixes
changes: FIX: Micro-Grenade now detonates on live enemy-owned body and child contacts, including point-blank launch overlap, without duplicate detonation or damage.
FIX: District arrival titles freeze during Pause and resume their existing animation and crosshair timing afterward.
FIX: Bullet Rain recognizes authored Chapter district and corridor floors; its placement circle and cast share the validated ground target. Invalid aim still cannot cast.
NEW: COMMUNICATIONS REPAIRED appears once at 100/100 through the existing objective notification. Survivors still block Finalize Repairs until cleared.
PRESERVED: District 1 combat/gate flow, the v0.1.88 repair-zone occupancy fix, enemy speed 2.5, and the verified District 2 checkpoint and return blocker.

updates.headline: v0.1.88 — Moving Repair Zone Edge Occupancy
updates.summary: Partially standing over the moving repair zone now counts when the player's physical controller overlaps the visible area.

categories.name: Gameplay fix
changes: Moving Communications Repair now counts the player's actual CharacterController footprint overlapping the zone, so repair continues while partly standing over an edge and stops when clearly outside.

The moving repair zone remains visually 3x3 with the same vertical allowance, 4-unit movement speed, bounds, repair pacing and projectile filtering. Authored markers and District 1 mission flow are unchanged.

updates.headline: v0.1.87 — District 2 transition and checkpoint
updates.summary: District 1 now leads into a persistent District 2 checkpoint with a safe one-way boundary and restored Chapter progression.

categories.name: Offline Chapter 1
changes: NEW: After DISTRICT 1 SECURED, crossing the authored District 2 boundary safely activates an invisible one-way return wall once the player fully clears it.
NEW: District 2 entry marks Mission 1-1 complete, advances Chapter stage to 1-2 and saves the authored District2CheckpointSpawn through the existing Offline campaign system.
NEW: Continue and current-stage Restart restore District 2, the return blocker and the earned player build without replaying District 1.
PRESERVED: District 1 repair cleanup, ambush, lock recovery, HUD and authored standard enemy movement speed 2.5. District 2 gameplay is still to be designed.

updates.headline: v0.1.86 — Repair Completion Cleanup Gate
updates.summary: Clear surviving repair-pressure enemies before Finalize Repairs becomes available.

categories.name: Repair Completion
changes: DISTRICT 1: At 100/100 communications repair, new pressure spawning stops and the player must clear surviving owned repair-pressure enemies before SignalZone_End or FINALIZE REPAIRS activates. The final survivor death immediately unlocks the existing five-second hold; no additional cleanup wave is spawned.

categories.name: Combat Timing
changes: DPS PASSIVE: Timing remains active during repair-survivor cleanup and freezes when Finalize Repairs downtime begins. The existing gate, fake escape, ambush, lock recovery and secured completion remain unchanged. Authored standard enemy movement speed 2.5, repair settings, UI and scene transforms are preserved.

updates.headline: v0.1.85 — District 1 Fake Escape, Ambush and Gate Recovery
updates.summary: A false exit leads into a forty-enemy ambush, ordered lock recovery, and genuine District 1 completion.

categories.name: Fake Escape
changes: DISTRICT 1: Added the second-half fake escape. Finalize Repairs opens the existing gate and shows DISTRICT 1 CLEARED without completing the mission. A world-only DISTRICT 2 beacon uses the existing off-screen navigation marker.

categories.name: Ambush
changes: AMBUSH: The authored player-only one-shot sensor clears the beacon, slides the same gate shut in 0.55 seconds, and presents a two-second red WATCH OUT warning with an original triangle icon. Four configurable groups of ten arrive two seconds apart using the existing fair District 1 spawn sources and safety checks.

categories.name: Gate Recovery
changes: RECOVERY: DEFEAT THE AMBUSH tracks 40 legitimate owned deaths; surviving or cleanup-removed enemies cannot falsely complete it. Then restore Left and Right locks in order with two-second continuous holds that reset on exit. The normal 1.5-second gate opening ends with DISTRICT 1 SECURED and genuine runtime completion.

categories.name: Existing Flow
changes: PRESERVATION: DPS passive timing resumes for ambush combat and freezes during recovery without changing stacks. Authored transforms, the arrival title, opening clear, repair latch, 15-enemy repair cap, 4/3/2/1 intervals, projectile safety, HUD, cards and crosshair are retained. District 2 gameplay and entry/checkpoint remain future work.

updates.headline: v0.1.84 — District Arrival and Distributed Repair Pressure
updates.summary: A centered District 1 arrival title, fair spawning across authored regions, and a 15-enemy repair-pressure cap.

categories.name: Area Arrival
changes: ARRIVAL: DISTRICT 1 now appears as a large centered location title with a smooth fade/slide, a 2.5-second readable hold and clean exit during the existing quiet arrival. The crosshair hides while the title is visible and returns afterward. CLEAR THE DISTRICT remains the normal objective notification.

categories.name: Spawn Distribution
changes: REPAIR SPAWNS: Existing District 1 volumes now use a shuffled source bag instead of restarting each one-enemy search at the first wall. Safe sources share pressure, consecutive source repeats are avoided when alternatives are valid, and positions still vary within authored regions. Player clearance, zone exclusion and ground/collision safety are preserved.

categories.name: Repair Pressure
changes: REPAIR CAP: Reduced the shared configurable active pressure cap from 20 to 15 across all four bands. The 4/3/2/1-second intervals, first-entry encounter latch, no-backlog behavior, stopping at 100, DPS passive timing, projectile filtering and final gate flow remain unchanged.

updates.headline: v0.1.83 — Repair Encounter Pressure and Projectile Safety
updates.summary: First-entry repair pressure, four stronger spawn bands, non-blocking objective zones and DPS passive downtime support.

categories.name: Repair Encounter
changes: DISTRICT 1: Repair pressure begins on the first signal-zone entry. After that, spawning continues even outside the zone until repair reaches 100; leaving pauses repair progress only. Four configurable intervals now use 4/3/2/1 seconds across 0–25/25–50/50–75/75–100, with a configurable active cap of 20 and no queued spawn bursts.

categories.name: Projectile Safety
changes: PROJECTILE SAFETY: Objective detection volumes are excluded from Micro-Grenade impact queries and DPS primary flight. Grenades can cross static and moving repair zones while player occupancy remains functional; the floor visual remains non-colliding.

categories.name: DPS Passive
changes: DPS PASSIVE: Existing grace/decay timing now freezes through Chapter-controlled downtime before repair begins and after surviving repair enemies are cleared. Timing resumes for the repair encounter and remains active outside the zone and while survivors remain after 100. Mission transitions neither reset nor grant stacks.

updates.headline: v0.1.82 — DPS Aim Alignment and Progressive Repair Pressure
updates.summary: Primary shots follow the compact crosshair, while District 1 repair pressure increases through three configurable bands.

categories.name: DPS Aim
changes: DPS AIM: Real primary shots now match the existing compact one-, two-, and three-projectile crosshair markers. Shared marker-to-camera aim drives muzzle convergence, with close-cover obstruction checks; weapon damage, speed, range, crit and projectile counts are unchanged.

categories.name: District 1 Repair
changes: DISTRICT 1: Repair enemy pressure now rises with progress: below 50 uses a four-second spawn interval and cap four; 50 to below 75 uses two seconds and cap five; 75 to below 100 uses one second and cap six. Thresholds, intervals and caps are configurable.

DISTRICT 1: Preserved authored spawn sources, six-unit player clearance, active-zone avoidance and legitimate enemy/XP ownership. Capped attempts do not queue bursts, and new pressure spawning still stops at 100 before Finalize Repairs. The established mission, zone, HUD, cards, minimap and gate flow remain unchanged.

updates.headline: v0.1.81 — District 1 Mission Flow: First Half
updates.summary: Clear the initial threat, repair communications through static and moving zones, and hold the final signal to open the gate.

categories.name: District 1 Flow
changes: CHAPTER 1: Replaced the earlier three-batch prototype with a District 1 intro, exactly ten legitimate initial kills, and a five-second post-clear beat before communications repair.

CHAPTER 1: Repair communications in a static 5×5 area from 0 to 50, then follow the same 3×3 area as it bounces within authored bounds from 50 to 100. Repair advances one point per second only while inside; leaving pauses progress.

CHAPTER 1: Authored District 1 enemy sources supply configurable repair pressure. At 100, new spawning stops and a five-second continuous hold at the final signal zone opens the existing animated gate. Surviving pressure enemies remain; ambush and door-lock recovery are future work.

categories.name: Existing Systems
changes: PRESENTATION: Reused existing objective notifications, world/minimap waypoints and contextual progress. Authored positions, HUD, cards, minimap framing, canonical combat and normal XP are preserved.

updates.headline: v0.1.80 — Reusable Chapter Objective Foundation
updates.summary: Reusable world/minimap waypoints and rectangular floor zones are ready for development preview, with authored Chapter locations preserved.

categories.name: Objective Foundation
changes: CHAPTER FOUNDATION: Added reusable objective waypoints with configurable labels, category icons, optional distance, and off-screen direction indicators. One target API drives both the world indication and the existing Chapter minimap.

CHAPTER FOUNDATION: Added reusable rectangular ObjectiveZone detection and an original floor border with subtle translucent fill. Authored footprints stay intact, jumping remains inside the taller detection area, and 5×5 zones can resize to 3×3 at runtime.

categories.name: Development Preview
changes: DEVELOPMENT: Chapter1_Blockout now provides preview actions for the authored signal and door targets, zone visibility, and zone sizes. Existing HUD, district/corridor framing, combat prototype, and gate flow remain intact; signal repair, moving zones, ambushes, door interactions, and the new District 1 mission sequence are future work.

updates.headline: v0.1.79 — Chapter 1-1 Playtest Polish
updates.summary: Larger player HUD, smaller tighter card choices, sealed gate backing and progressively revealed combat targets.

categories.name: HUD and Cards
changes: HUD: Compact Player HUD increased from 1.3 to 1.6. Armor and HP keep their width, use 0.9 height scale, and sit closely together; LEVEL UP now appears above the vitals.
CARDS: Bottom-left card choices now use a smaller 1.2 presentation with tighter spacing and fit beside the player HUD. Existing selection, animations, and queued offers remain intact.

categories.name: Chapter 1-1
